sub_graphs.title: EIP-1679: Istanbul Hardfork Activation
sub_graphs.description: Models the network-wide activation of the Istanbul hardfork at specified block numbers across different Ethereum networks

nodes.label: Block Before Istanbul Fork
nodes.description: System state before reaching the Istanbul activation block number

nodes.label: Check Fork Block Number
nodes.description: Compare current block number against Istanbul activation block (e.g., 9,069,000 for mainnet)

nodes.label: Istanbul Fork Active
nodes.description: System state after reaching Istanbul activation block; new rules apply

nodes.label: Apply Istanbul Protocol Rules
nodes.description: Activate all EIPs bundled in Istanbul: EIP-152, EIP-1108, EIP-1344, EIP-1884, EIP-2028, EIP-2200

edges.label: Process new block and check fork threshold

sub_graphs.title: EIP-1679: Istanbul Gas Repricing
sub_graphs.description: Models the gas cost changes introduced by Istanbul including EIP-1108, EIP-1884, EIP-2028, and EIP-2200

nodes.label: Opcode Execution Requested
nodes.description: An EVM opcode is about to be executed and gas cost must be calculated

nodes.label: Calculate Pre-Istanbul Gas Cost
nodes.description: Calculate gas using original (higher) costs for state-access and EC operations

nodes.label: Calculate Post-Istanbul Gas Cost
nodes.description: Calculate gas using reduced costs: alt_bn128 ops (EIP-1108), SLOAD/BALANCE/EXTCODE (EIP-1884), calldata (EIP-2028), SSTORE (EIP-2200)

nodes.label: Gas Deducted from Limit
nodes.description: Calculated gas cost has been deducted from the transaction's gas limit

nodes.label: Out of Gas Error
nodes.description: Transaction execution halted due to insufficient gas

sub_graphs.title: EIP-1679: Istanbul Precompiled Contract Additions
sub_graphs.description: Models the addition of Blake2b precompile (EIP-152) and efficiency improvements to bn128 precompiles (EIP-1108)

nodes.label: Precompile Call Received
nodes.description: A CALL to a precompiled contract address has been initiated

nodes.label: Validate Precompile Address
nodes.description: Check if address is a valid precompile (including new 0x09 Blake2b)

nodes.label: Execute Blake2b Compression
nodes.description: Execute Blake2b compression function F at address 0x09 (EIP-152)

nodes.label: Execute BN128 Addition
nodes.description: Execute alt_bn128 curve addition with reduced gas (EIP-1108)

nodes.label: Execute BN128 Multiplication
nodes.description: Execute alt_bn128 curve multiplication with reduced gas (EIP-1108)

nodes.label: Execute BN128 Pairing
nodes.description: Execute alt_bn128 pairing check with reduced gas (EIP-1108)

nodes.label: Precompile Result Ready
nodes.description: Precompile execution completed successfully with output data

nodes.label: Precompile Execution Failed
nodes.description: Precompile execution failed due to invalid input or out of gas

external_entities.name: Calling Contract
external_entities.description: Smart contract or EOA initiating a call to a precompiled contract

ambiguities.text: The specification does not detail the exact behavior if a node has not upgraded when the fork block is reached
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume non-upgraded nodes will continue on the old chain, creating a potential fork. This is standard hardfork behavior.

ambiguities.text: The meta-EIP references included EIPs without detailing their interaction effects
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume each included EIP is independent and does not conflict with others. Refer to individual EIPs for detailed specifications.

implicit_assumptions.description: All major Ethereum clients have correctly implemented the bundled EIPs and will activate them at the specified block numbers
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Network could split if clients implement the fork differently or at different blocks

implicit_assumptions.description: The majority of network hashpower will upgrade before the fork block
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: The network could split, leaving some users on an unsupported chain

implicit_assumptions.description: Contracts relying on pre-Istanbul gas costs have been updated to handle the new gas pricing
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Legacy contracts could fail or behave unexpectedly due to gas repricing (especially EIP-1884 SLOAD increase)
